statements.status_notes: CVE-2023-25613 is an LDAP injection in Kerby's LdapIdentityBackend (ldap-backend module). The Kerby 1.0.1 classes reported here are copies shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime 3.3.6 and hbase-shaded-client 2.6.0, which bundle only the in-memory identity backend; neither jar, nor any other jar in the image, contains LdapIdentityBackend. The image's own Kerby jars are 2.1.2, which includes the fix. See https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-25613

Apache Kerby provides Kerberos support for the optional secured-HBase backend and is not used by the default gremlin-server. Upgrading to Kerby 2.x is a major bump that breaks reactor dependency convergence (nimbus-jose-jwt 10.x); reachability assessment pending.
Druid 36.0.0 bundles kerb-admin 1.0.1 as a transitive dependency; fix requires upstream Druid to repin to 2.0.3.
